from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single legal document for classification purposes."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The unique title of the document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action stated in the document (e.g., '侵害信息网络传播权纠纷', '公司解散纠纷')")
    case_procedure_type: str | None = Field(description="The procedural nature of the case (e.g., 'Civil', 'Criminal', 'Execution')")
    document_format: str | None = Field(description="The type of legal document (e.g., '民事二审终审判决书', '民事执行复议裁定书', '刑事再审判决书')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
